messages:
support_julia: Escalation — customer attempted to stream results to the rerank endpoint and is getting errors. They tried event-stream/ chunked upload. Posting example and server responses for repro.

support_julia: ```curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX' \
  -H 'Content-Type: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Transfer-Encoding: chunked' \
  --data-binary $'--chunk\n{"queries":["Which is best?"],"candidates":["A","B"]}\n--chunk\n'``` 

support_julia: Server reply (customer screenshot): HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
{ "error": "rerank endpoint does not support streaming. use application/json" }

support_julia: They also reported a separate run where the API returned scores like 1.2 and 1.5 which confused them (expecting normalized scores). Customer on larger payloads sometimes sees 400/422 too.

eng_vijay: Can you paste the exact JSON body they sent when they saw >1.0 scores? Also did they set any custom model params or post-processing locally? @support_julia

support_julia: Payload they pasted: ```{"queries":["best laptop"],"candidates":["X","Y"],"_meta":{"client_scale":100}}``` They said client multiplies by 100 for display in UI, but some runs show raw >1.0 in API response before client-side scaling. They used transfer-encoding chunked in both runs.

eng_vijay: Quick notes: rerank endpoint is synchronous and expects Content-Type: application/json and a full JSON payload. It doesn't accept chunked/event-stream. If you get >1.0 it's almost always client-side scaling or a model variant returning logits instead of normalized scores. Rerank returns scores in [0,1] for the verified models; custom or experimental models can return raw logits.

eng_vijay: Repro curl (non-streaming): ```curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-XXX' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"queries":["Which is best?"],"candidates":["A","B"]}'``` This should return 200 + JSON with scores array.

support_julia: Customer asks why the error message says Unsupported Media Type instead of telling them to use /v1/responses for streaming. Can we make it clearer?

product_ana: Filed INF-4321 to improve the 415 body and docs. We'll add a hint pointing to the streaming-capable endpoint and the expected content-type/schema.

sre_alex: I can push a small config change to return a more helpful error message for 415 on /v1/rerank. Will coordinate with eng. @eng_vijay any concerns?

eng_vijay: No concerns. Also add a short note in the API docs: \"rerank is synchronous; use /v1/responses for streaming and event-stream content-types\". For the score issue: ask customer to confirm model name; if it's a custom model we may need to normalize.

deploy_bot: deploy:infra 2026-03-14T09:12:00Z INF-4321 - staged -> deployed (staging)

sre_alex: Change is rolled to staging; prod rollout scheduled after QA signoff. This will make 415 include: \"This endpoint does not support streaming; send application/json or use /v1/responses for streaming. See docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/rerank\".

support_julia: Shared workaround with customer: switch Content-Type to application/json and send full JSON; or switch to /v1/responses if they need streaming. Customer confirmed switching to application/json fixed the 415 and scores normalized after they removed client-side scaling. Closing the loop.

support_julia: :white_check_mark: closing the thread, will update internal KB with the repro and fix steps.
